{
  "thinking": "Nobody has drawn anything yet and the clock is running. I'll take the pad and sketch a fish, since its outline and tail fin read clearly, with the start at the tail so the run flows rightward.",
  "say": "Okay, I'll take the pad and sketch a fish, starting at the tail end so the run goes left to right. Tail fin on the left, body and nose on the right. Shout if you'd rather do something else, but we need a plan in the next minute.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": false,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "line", "x0": 2, "y0": 10, "x1": 9, "y1": 10},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[9, 10], [11, 6.5], [16, 5.5], [21, 7], [24, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[9, 10], [11, 13.5], [16, 14.5], [21, 13], [24, 10]]},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 5, "y0": 10, "x1": 2, "y1": 6},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 5, "y0": 10, "x1": 2, "y1": 14},
    {"type": "label", "x": 2, "y": 10, "text": "START"},
    {"type": "label", "x": 20, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "I hold the pad. Plan: a fish facing right. Stroke 1 runs from START at the tail along the axis to the body's left junction at about (9,10). Strokes 2 and 3 are the top and bottom of the body, meeting at the nose (24,10). Strokes 4 and 5 are the tail fin, branching off stroke 1 at about (5,10). The eye is at about (20,9). Next: trace stroke 1 myself, then ask Maya, Tom and Priya to take the body and tail strokes."
}
